title: Readers-writers
description: Readers can overlap; the writer is exclusive.

input.code:
# First readers-writers problem: readers share, the writer is exclusive.
shared readcount = 0
shared data = 0
mutex mx
semaphore wrt = 1

thread Reader1
  LOCK mx
  LOAD r, readcount
  ADD r, 1
  STORE readcount, r
  SUB r, 1              ; r == 0 means this is the first reader
  JNZ r, enter
  WAIT wrt              ; the first reader locks out writers
enter:
  UNLOCK mx
  PRINT R1 reads
  LOCK mx
  LOAD r, readcount
  SUB r, 1
  STORE readcount, r
  JNZ r, leave
  SIGNAL wrt            ; the last reader lets writers in
leave:
  UNLOCK mx

thread Reader2
  LOCK mx
  LOAD r, readcount
  ADD r, 1
  STORE readcount, r
  SUB r, 1
  JNZ r, enter
  WAIT wrt
enter:
  UNLOCK mx
  PRINT R2 reads
  LOCK mx
  LOAD r, readcount
  SUB r, 1
  STORE readcount, r
  JNZ r, leave
  SIGNAL wrt
leave:
  UNLOCK mx

thread Writer
  WAIT wrt
  PRINT W writes
  LOAD r, data
  ADD r, 1
  STORE data, r
  SIGNAL wrt
